user_query: I am planning a surprise birthday party for my sister and I need some ideas for food and decorations. Can you suggest some chicken dishes and desserts that would be perfect for the party? Also, find some comments and ratings for the products I can use for the decorations.

TaskList.description: Gather a list of chicken dishes suitable for a birthday party.
Gather a list of dessert ideas suitable for the birthday party.
Retrieve comments and ratings for decoration products.
